objectives.missionText: Open the Rift terminal and descend to the surface.
objectives.instructionText: Walk to the bridge terminal. HELIX will route the first descent through tmux.

objectives.missionText: Find the Rift Code on the village perimeter.
objectives.instructionText: Talk to Zrix, then follow the path until you reach the glowing glyph.

objectives.missionText: Use the Rift Code to open the armory session.
objectives.instructionText: Return to Zrix. The armory can only be reached with tmux new -s armory.

objectives.missionText: Collect the bracket cannon from the armory.
objectives.instructionText: Step onto the weapon stand and retrieve the only tool that can erase the overflow.

objectives.missionText: Detach from the armory and return to the CLULIX bridge.
objectives.instructionText: Speak with the Armorer, then use Ctrl+b d to leave the armory alive behind you.

objectives.missionText: Inspect the Rift Manifest from the bridge terminal.
objectives.instructionText: Use tmux ls to confirm the surviving destinations before you jump back down.

objectives.missionText: Return to the surface Rift with the armory weapon.
objectives.instructionText: Finish the bridge terminal sequence and reattach to session 0.

objectives.missionText: Clear the overflow buffer blocking Starfall Village.
objectives.instructionText: Walk to the overflow front and press E to fire the bracket cannon.
